description: This Java class `EntityTagBuilder` is responsible for creating `EntityTag` objects based on a given entity or object. It distinguishes between entities that extend the `Entity` class and other objects, generating appropriate tags accordingly. It includes methods to build tags for top-level entities and sub-entities, with specific prefixes and formatting.

classes.name: EntityTagBuilder
classes.description: A utility class for constructing EntityTag instances from entities or objects, handling both top-level entities and sub-resources.

methods.name: buildFromEntity
methods.description: Creates an EntityTag for a given entity or object; returns empty if input is null or entity is deleted.

methods.name: buildForTopLevelEntity
methods.description: Builds an EntityTag for top-level entities that are not deleted, using their revision.

methods.name: buildForSubEntity
methods.description: Builds an EntityTag for non-entity objects based on their hash code.

methods.name: enquote
methods.description: Wraps a string in double quotes.
